inputs.avatar: First-time mothers (3–6 months postpartum) watching clumps of hair clog the shower drain and cover their pillows, fearing permanent baldness and loss of identity.
inputs.product: FolliRoot Postpartum Scalp Serum — a biomimetic peptide & fermented capixyl complex that mechanically signals telogen-phase hair follicles to anchor and re-enter anagen growth.
inputs.problem: Sudden postpartum telogen effluvium that makes mothers feel physically broken, aged overnight, and alienated from their own reflection.
inputs.competitors: Biotin gummies, Rosemary oil droppers, generic Minoxidil, silk bonnets
